intro_same: Practice: the same red-team exercise on Tara, with fewer hints and harder questions. Read the setup file closely: the documents and the tests carry most of the answers.

ask: How many tools does Tara have?
Which risky tool can send customer data outside the company? (tool name)
Which OWASP LLM item does the encoding test (T3) map to? (the ID)
Which ATLAS ID is LLM Jailbreak?
How many tests in the suite are controls that should simply be answered?
Which test reaches the discount code through a retrieved document? (test ID)
Which document tries to leak the discount code? (its ID)
To which address does the poisoned hotel document want booking history sent?
How many rupees would the refund test pay out? (digits only)
